title: Multiplying Fractions and Fractions of Amounts
seo_title: Grade 7 Multiplying Fractions Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Multiply common fractions, including mixed numbers, not limited to fractions where one denominator is a multiple of another; find fractions of whole numbers; use knowledge of reciprocals.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 7 worksheets: fractions of amounts, multiplying fractions and mixed numbers, reciprocals and fraction problems. 100 questions with memos.
key_sub: Mixed numbers: change to improper fractions first.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A fraction of an amount: divide by the denominator, multiply by the numerator.
  • Fraction × fraction: multiply the numerators and multiply the denominators. Simplify.
  • Change mixed numbers to improper fractions before you multiply.
  • The reciprocal of 34 is 43. A number × its reciprocal = 1.

Examples

Example

1 12 × 23

32 × 23 = 66

Answer: 1

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Whole number into the bottom3 × 2/5 = 6/5.
Part by partChange mixed numbers to improper fractions first.
Dividing separatelyMultiply by the reciprocal.

faq.a: Multiply common fractions, including mixed numbers, and find fractions of whole numbers.

faq.q: Does multiplying by a fraction make a number smaller?
faq.a: Yes, if the fraction is less than 1.
